stage0047_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well, the opening move failed...
　guess I'll try an AS next」

stage0047_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$マオ$$
「A $$マーティアル$$ unit, huh...!」

stage0047_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But they don't have their ATs.」

stage0047_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$マオ$$
「...So that old acquaintance of Sousuke's...
　might be from a group other than $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0047_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So palling around with $$マーティアル$$
　was just for convenience, huh...」

stage0047_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Their target is $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$ at Jindai High.
　Don't let them break through, no matter what!」

stage0047_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$n
「Don't think you can barge into our school...!」

stage0047_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルト$$
「Wait for me, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$...
　I'll definitely protect you both.」

stage0047_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, you!
　A battle's about to start, is this the time!?」

stage0047_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$宗介$$
「What I started to say earlier in the club room...」

stage0047_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Summer break starts tomorrow...
　Will you come to the beach with me?」

stage0047_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm serious.
　I've been meaning to ask you for a while.」

stage0047_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$宗介$$
「There's no time.
　Give me your answer.」

stage0047_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「F-fine!
　If you insist, I guess I could go with you...」

stage0047_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Since we made a promise, come back safe.」

stage0047_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Make sure you protect Jindai High.」

stage0047_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$恭子$$
「Talking with Sagara, huh? Something good happen?」

stage0047_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana's on a roll these days.
　Aced STEM out of nowhere, top of the grade.」

stage0047_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Haha... guess life's giving me a good wave...」

stage0047_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ランカ$$
「That person... what a nice smile.」

stage0047_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Heh heh... summer's already here.」

stage0047_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$マオ$$
「Not yet!
　The unit hasn't exploded!」

stage0047_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Wait, $$宗介$$!
　That red unit is signaling surrender!」

stage0047_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Heh, you got me.
　Bring out a new model and it overheats.」

stage0047_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I surrender...
　Do what you want.」

stage0047_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「For now, all enemies have withdrawn.」

stage0047_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I can't shoot someone who's surrendered.
　Let's leave the rest to $$ミスリル$$,
　who's investigating their group.」

stage0047_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You can shoot me, Kashim.
　Dying by your hand would be an honor.」

stage0047_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Hahahaha!
　You've really changed, Kashim!」

stage0047_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$宗介$$
「I made a promise to Chidori...!
　Let's finish this quickly!」

stage0047_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガウルン$$!
　It's about time we settled this!」

stage0047_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Bring it on, Kashim.
　Though fighting you now
　isn't much fun anymore.」

stage0047_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't have time for your games!」

stage0047_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Busy with a date with that girl, huh?
　You really have changed, Kashim.」

stage0047_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No, I won't shut up.
　I liked the old you better, Kashim.」

stage0047_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Please, go back to how you were!
　My beloved Kashim...!」

stage0047_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$宗介$$
「I said shut up, $$ガウルン$$!!」

stage0047_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$甲児$$
「Messing with our school...
　you've got some nerve!」

stage0047_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come and get me, if you dare!
　$$兜甲児$$, Jindai High's top tough guy, awaits!」

stage0047_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey, you punks...!
　Cleaning up the school's junk
　is the janitor's job!」

stage0047_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's how it is!
　The fools who messed with Jindai High,
　I'll clean up myself!」

stage0047_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Jindai High is our other school too!
　I'll definitely protect it!」

stage0047_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now that I think about it, most of
　the volunteer club's work was trash cleanup...」

stage0047_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$アルト$$
「And now it's terrorist extermination...!
　More trash cleanup, huh!」

stage0047_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$カレン$$
「Japan's finally at peace...
　and you attack this city full of schools...!」

stage0047_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'll never forgive your dirty tactics!
　I'll crush you completely myself!」

stage0047_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$n
「Coming right as summer break starts...
　these guys can't read the room at all...!」

stage0047_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$スズネ$$
「About the final exam before that,
　I need to talk to $n later.」

stage0047_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$...!
　Now's not the time for that...!」

stage0047_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I told you from the start, $n.
　I want everyone to balance
　school life and battle.」

stage0047_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If you can't manage that,
　I've got my own plans, you know!」

stage0047_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「A-alright...!
　Once this battle's over, I'll hear you out!」

stage0047_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Good...!
　Now, hurry up and clean up the enemy!」
